paragraphs: 4 former Mustangs appeared in professional games on Saturday for 4 clubs across 3 levels, with Brooks Lee producing the night's most notable performance.

Brooks Lee's home run — his 19th of the season came in the second inning on a 0-1 92 mph four-seam fastball from Casey Mize. The swing moved the score from 1-0 to 2-0. Statcast measured the ball at 97.5 mph off the bat, a 36-degree launch angle, 366 feet.
Brooks Lee produced a double in the fourth to deep center field on a 1-0 91 mph four-seam fastball from Kyle Hart.
Brooks Lee went 3-for-4, 1 home run, 1 double, 1 RBI, 2 runs scored.
He batted eighth and started at third base.
Minnesota Twins fell to San Diego Padres, 5-7.
Ryan Tayman went 1-for-3, 1 run scored, 2 walks for St. Lucie Mets at Single-A. He batted second and started behind the plate. St. Lucie Mets beat Lakeland Flying Tigers, 6-2.
Zach Daudet went 1-for-2, 1 run scored, 2 walks for Asheville Tourists at High-A. He batted sixth and started at shortstop. Asheville Tourists fell to Brooklyn Cyclones, 3-15.
Alejandro Garza went 0-for-1 for Hill City Howlers at Single-A. He batted first and started at second base. Hill City Howlers beat Charleston RiverDogs, 1-0.
title: Brooks Lee turns around 92 mph for home run No. 19
